family_reports.body: Doubled down on the abuse to the victim, failed the child, extorted the protective parent while letting the perpetrators alienate the child from a loving fit parent.

Miami county doesn’t have the child best interest at all, they literally take children away from a parent who wants to protect them from abuse and drugs and tells the parent that wants to keep them safe that they are a vindictive ex who is mad!

The system took my kids a whole year without due process. It cost me everything that I value. I'm sharing this because I want people to know that this is immoral, illegal, and unconstitutional. These people need to be held accountable for all their actions. Meg I need your help please.
The system and those in it s have systematically and meticulously destroyed the relationship I had with my son and the relationship between siblings based upon nothing more than their personal biases
